papers.title: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
papers.core_finding: 138,000+ earnings press releases (2005-2023): soft information from 8-K press releases is as informative as earnings surprises for announcement-day returns. FinBERT embeddings outperform LDA.

papers.title: Which Voices Move Markets? Speaker Identity and the Cross-Section of Post-Earnings Returns
papers.core_finding: Speaker-weighted FinBERT on 16,428 S&P 500 calls (2015-2025): Analyst 49%, CFO 30%, Executive 16%. Monthly alpha 2.03% (t=6.49), IC=0.142. Previously known — H168 was based on this paper.
papers.note: Already incorporated as H168 basis; H168 NOT CONFIRMED due to OOS coverage bias, not paper methodology

papers.title: Corporate Earnings Calls and Analyst Beliefs
papers.core_finding: Narratives from earnings calls predict analyst expectations. Under-reaction to uncertainty/confidence; over-reaction to sentiment/global perspective.

papers.title: Evaluating LLMs for Stance Detection on Financial Targets from SEC Filings and Earnings Calls
papers.core_finding: LLMs for stance detection (bullish/neutral/bearish) on specific metrics from 8-K and earnings calls.

searches.query: Short-term reversal + industry adjustment + idiosyncratic reversal

papers.title: Discovery of a 13-Sharpe OOS Factor: Drift Regimes Unlock Hidden Cross-Sectional Predictability
papers.core_finding: Value + short-term reversal conditioned on stock-specific drift regime (>60% positive days in 63d window) achieves 13.2 OOS Sharpe, CAGR 158.6%, MaxDD -11.9%, 2004-2024. Walk-forward validated, p<0.001.

papers.title: Trends and Reversion in Financial Markets on Time Scales from Minutes to Decades
papers.core_finding: Small trends persist up to ~2 years; trend-reversion interplay documented. Informs holding period for reversal strategy.

searches.query: Cross-sectional momentum + factor momentum + sector momentum

papers.title: Follow the Leader: Enhancing Systematic Trend-Following Using Network Momentum
papers.core_finding: Combines time-series and cross-sectional momentum via lead-lag network. Network momentum captures inter-market spillover and outperforms univariate trends.

papers.title: Cross-Market Alpha: Testing Short-Term Trading Factors in the U.S. Market via Double-Selection LASSO
papers.core_finding: 17 Alpha191 factors with significant cross-sectional explanatory power in U.S. markets (LASSO-screened). Short-term predictability confirmed in 2026 U.S. data.
papers.note: Useful reference for H156 factor selection when unbiased data available

papers.title: TrendFolios: Portfolio Construction Framework for Momentum and Trend-Following
papers.core_finding: Sector momentum + factor momentum applied to factor ETF rotations across equity styles. Validates combined approach.

papers.title: Spatio-Temporal Momentum: Jointly Learning Time-Series and Cross-Sectional Strategies
papers.core_finding: Unified framework for time-series + cross-sectional momentum. Foundation for H183 implementation.

papers.title: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
papers.core_finding: Bull/Bear researcher agents + risk management team + trader. Simulates collaborative trading. Foundation for H165.
papers.note: H165 already QUEUED based on this paper

papers.title: ATLAS: Adaptive Trading with LLM AgentS (Dynamic Prompt Optimization + Multi-Agent)
papers.core_finding: OPRO-based adaptive prompt optimization for LLM trading agents. Handles delayed/obscured market feedback via stochastic OPRO.

papers.title: StockBench: Can LLM Agents Trade Stocks Profitably In Real-world Markets?
papers.core_finding: Benchmark confirming LLM agents can trade profitably in real-world multi-month environments.

papers.title: Toward Expert Investment Teams: A Multi-Agent LLM System with Fine-Grained Trading Tasks
papers.core_finding: Task decomposition into specialized agents for fine-grained trading decisions.

papers.title: AlphaQuanter: Tool-Augmented Agentic RL Framework for Stock Trading
papers.core_finding: Single-agent RL (Qwen2.5 backbone) outperforms multi-agent on end-to-end optimization. Interpretable tool-augmented decision workflow.
papers.hypothesis: H165 (comparison: single-agent RL vs multi-agent LLM)

key_insights: arXiv:2511.12490 (13-Sharpe drift-regime factor) is the most novel finding: drift-regime conditioning on short-term reversal may unlock much larger alpha than raw industry-adjusted reversal (H181). Queue H182 immediately after H181.
arXiv:2509.24254 independently validates H163/H174 — the deployed paper trading strategy has strong academic backing from 138k+ press releases analysis.
ModernFinBERT (July 2025) is a potential H176 — drop-in upgrade to the H163/H174 scoring model. Low cost, 2h to validate.
Network momentum (arXiv:2501.07135) proposes a daily-frequency signal that complements H026's monthly rotation — could fill the gap left by H157 NOT CONFIRMED.
H165 (TradingAgents) is validated by StockBench (March 2026 confirms real-market profitability). ATLAS prompt optimization is a meaningful enhancement to the original TradingAgents framework.
